content: 56 of 104 Document ID 977: AUTOSAR_SWS_IntrusionDetectionSystemManager Specification of Intrusion Detection System Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 API Function Header File Description StbM_GetCurrentTime StbM.h Returns a time value (Local Time Base derived from Global Time Base) in standard format. Note: This API shall be called with locked interrupts / within an Exclusive Area to prevent interruption (i.e., the risk that the time stamp is outdated on return of the function call).
